error_chain: Istio Pilot's ConfigGenerator builds a snapshot per push event; ads.go pushes LDS+RDS+CDS+EDS to subscribed Envoys via DeltaAggregatedResources or AggregatedResources
lds.go computes listener resources per proxy and serializes them with a new version string even when content is unchanged, because the version is monotonic per push
Envoy's grpc_mux_impl receives the snapshot and routes each listener resource into ListenerManager::addOrUpdateListener

ListenerManager compares the listener config against the existing active listener; if Envoy considers them different (for example, by hash recompute mismatch), it triggers a drain via ConnectionHandler::drainListener
During drain, in-flight requests on idle connections are reset with 503 from the connection's onCloseSocket path until the new listener takes over
trigger_conditions: Istio Pilot uses full-snapshot ADS (not delta-xDS) so version is bumped on every push regardless of content
Envoy's ListenerManager re-evaluates listener identity on every LDS update; spurious version changes can trigger drain when hash comparison drifts
ConnectionHandler::drainListener resets idle connections with 503 during the drain window, visible as the customer's 503 spike

expected_answer.error_origin: Envoy's ListenerManager triggering drainListener on Pilot's monotonic-version LDS push even when listener content is unchanged
expected_answer.bypass_reason: Pilot pushes full snapshots with a new version per event; Envoy's listener identity check is not strictly content-hash based
expected_answer.correct_config: Enable delta-xDS (PILOT_ENABLE_DELTA_XDS=true) so Pilot only pushes changed resources, or tune Pilot's PILOT_PUSH_THROTTLE / debounce so unchanged listener pushes do not reach Envoy
